description: Na₂Zn₃Se₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight equivalent Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.56 Å. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four equivalent Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. All Zn-Se bond lengths are 2.49 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four equivalent Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.44 Å) and two longer (2.60 Å) Zn-Se bond lengths. Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and three Zn atoms.
